_about: The stove-top kitchen's own numbers, the same for every kitchen game. notYetEveryMs, noEveryMs: Nani's 'not yet' (a knob before the green) and her 'no' (a wrong thing refused) are not said again within this long; a 'no' asked for while she speaks is said straight after, never dropped.

heat._about: greenRate: from the green on, the heat climbs at this share of the level's rate. overResetMs: how long a spoiled vessel shows before it starts again. holdAt: where in the green a first-time player's heat waits (share of the band). bubbleLead: the boil shows this many seconds before the green, never under bubbleMin. near: the knob is the step from this far below the green. calmMs: a boil settling to calm as the heat is turned down, through half, its heat ring and its sound going with it, never in the way of a tap (Zafar, 21 Nov: "from boiling to semi-boiling to calm ... slow enough that you can see the transition"; 0.4 s, then "an extra 0.1 seconds longer", Zafar, 21 Nov).

lines._about: Nani's lines for the kitchen's own steps, as meanings for the language engine. use: put this thing in ($item is the thing). light, turn-down: the knob. Picking the next vessel shows that vessel's next line, said only with the pick's stuck help, never as it opens (old js/cook/stations/chai-tray.js:393-409); a control's call comes at its step's moment (lights), together with its first light (old js/cook/coach.js:800-840; values.md:82-83).

art._about: The kitchen's own pictures, by art id. hob: by how many burners.

layout._about: The play area from above, in design px (a 1600 x 900 sheet; more worktop shows above it on a taller screen). play: the worktop the hob and serving spot are laid out in. hobK: the hob's scale. spot: the serving spot's widest, and gap: its distance from the hob. vesselR: a vessel's widest radius; rim: the rim's share of it. frontStrip: where the hob's front strip sits, by burners. pillRoom: screen px kept above the hob for the count pills where the play area has room (a short one keeps the hob's size and the pills overlap its top edge). badge, knob, off: the face and knob on the front strip. band: the bottom row's band, base line and pill line; slot: a slot's width; groupGap: between groups; margin: from the view's sides. sizes: a thing's height by size class, as shares of the band's room.

hob._about: How the hob draws the heat and the knob. ring: the ring on the vessel's rim, each layer as [width, colour, strength]; sweep: the heat so far (gold, red past the green); dot: the hand at its end. knob: its angle when off, high and low, and how long it and the flames take to change.

cook._about: The cook scene's small numbers. pointMs: how long the thing the fire needs is pointed at. flameAfterMs: the flame's sound after the knob's click. vesselWiggle: a vessel refusing a tap. ground: the worktop's tiling and its warm wash. countPill: the count pills' place above the hob, in screen px (between: the gap between two pills side by side). wordPop: a word's pop just above the hob (design px, at least so many screen px), or overPillsPx screen px above the count pills, or besidePillsPx beside them where the top has no room.

lights._about: When a step's moment comes (js/kitchen/cook.rules.js), in milliseconds on the round's clock, carried from old chai's rule table (old docs/design-language/standard/values.md:78-102, D1 the first time). The rules time every movement they start (a pour, a spoonful, a serve); the moment waits for the last to end, then a breath, never longer than the most: breathMs, breathMaxMs (old js/shared/onboard.js:426 Onboard.WAIT breath 1000, breathMax 3000; values.md:82; chai-tray.js:274 CONTROL_PAUSE_MS) for a thing's first light and a control's call; a pour waits only for the stillness (old chai-tray.js:1964). The first thing asked for: its card is lit cardStillMs after the stillness (old data/rules.json showing.pointAfterMoveMs), and never before the order list has stopped after the step opened (kit.json panel.settleMs, the list's longest move; so the light never waits on the list itself), waiting at most cardMaxMs (Onboard.WAIT.still), for cardLitMs: 1500, Zafar's own measure (18 Nov: "a brief highlight of milk item card, which only lasts about 1.5 secs"), over old's 1200 (showing.pointMs). The next vessel: its first light nextAfterMs after the first dish's pour ends (Onboard.WAIT.nextVessel; old chai-tray.js:1440, 1606-1607, 1713: never while another dish is on the heat or waiting to be poured), its stuck help counted from the stillness. At the moment a first-time light is spent (only then: old chai-tray.js:1950-1956), and the stuck help's wait starts again, as the end of each movement restarts it (old js/cook/stations/chai-tray.js:1433-1437). cardMargin: px round a lit card.

steam._about: Steam over a vessel at the boil, in vessel-rim radii and milliseconds: a wisp every so often, rising and fading; two puffs at a boil-over. Past the green the boil-over shows already and grows until the pan spills (Zafar, 19 Nov: 'the boiling over look starts as soon as the heat passes the green and grows'): its puffs come every overEveryMs, from the first to the second as the heat climbs to the spill, each overGrow (from, to) of a boil-over's own; drawn with the steam wisps until its own art comes (the boil-over, still to make).

pourMoment._about: The kitchen's act in the word moment (js/kitchen/pour-moment.js): a kettle pours each glass to its measure. Sizes and times (ms) the old game's (old js/shared/word-moment.js at speed 0.75), the pour's end Zafar's (18 Nov). pitch: glasses stand this many glass-widths apart; side: the room at the sides; glassMost: a glass's most, as a share of the height; top, topMin: the room kept at the top; gap: the stream's gap above the rim and above: the kettle's height above its spout, in glasses (old :178-215). streamW: the stream's width, in glasses (old :346); streamEdge: the soft edge of its front and end, a share of its length (old :301); fall: things fall as time to this power, slow from the spout, then quicker (old :312). dropW: the last drop, in glasses (old :447). startMs: before the kettle comes; soundWaitMs: it waits at most this long for the pour's sound (old :168, POUR_WAIT, not slowed); moveMs, moveEase: the kettle moving (old :327, :337); tipMs: it tips forward (old :393-394); runMs: the stream running down (old :406); pourBaseMs + pourFullMs x the measure: the tea rising (old :416), at one rate, as the tea lands, until the stream's last reaches it (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'the tea level should keep rising while any part of the poured stream is visible'; the old ease-out, old :428, stopped the level while the stream still showed); tailMs: the stream ending from the top down (old :438), started this long before the tea stops so the last of it lands as the level stops; dropAfterMs: the last drop leaves the spout this long into the end, and lands with it (old :450); afterPourMs: after the tea stops (old :460: 800 ms from the end starting), halved; awayMs: after the last glass the kettle starts going and the look begins this long after, half its move (Zafar, 19 Nov: the wait from the last glass to the first photo halved, about 2 s to 1 s). cardOfGlass, cardRoom: the word card's width for a glass, its size before the counter's room shrank it times this, never wider than its share of the room less cardRoom px (old :520). rimClip: the glass's front lip, laid back over the stream so the stream goes into the glass (rows 3 to 5% of the glass: old css/shared/word-moment.css:29-30).
